sample_size.excerpt: Pre-diagnostic metabolite concentrations and prostate cancer risk in 1077 cases and 1077 matched controls in the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition.

cases.excerpt: Pre-diagnostic metabolite concentrations and prostate cancer risk in 1077 cases and 1077 matched controls in the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition.

effect_size.excerpt: Citrulline was associated with a decreased risk of prostate cancer (odds ratio (OR<sub>1SD</sub>) = 0.73; 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.62-0.86; p <sub>trend</sub> = 0.0002) in the first 5 years of follow-up after taking multiple testing into account, but not after longer follow-up; results for other metabolites did not vary by time to diagnosis.

confidence_interval.excerpt: Citrulline was associated with a decreased risk of prostate cancer (odds ratio (OR<sub>1SD</sub>) = 0.73; 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.62-0.86; p <sub>trend</sub> = 0.0002) in the first 5 years of follow-up after taking multiple testing into account, but not after longer follow-up; results for other metabolites did not vary by time to diagnosis.

disease_scope_review.endpoint_excerpt: Citrulline was associated with a decreased risk of prostate cancer (odds ratio (OR<sub>1SD</sub>) = 0.73; 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.62-0.86; p <sub>trend</sub> = 0.0002) in the first 5 years of follow-up after taking multiple testing into account, but not after longer follow-up; results for other metabolites did not vary by time to diagnosis.
disease_scope_review.reason: This estimate concerns prostate cancer overall during the first five years after blood collection, not an advanced or otherwise aggressive endpoint.

evidence_scope_projection.definition: Overall prostate cancer evidence, excluding estimates solely about aggressive prostate cancer. General estimates from papers that also report aggressive endpoints remain included. Uncertain endpoints retain their existing review and pooling restrictions.
